acceptance: Idempotent preflight/setup/status/rollback automation manages only marked dsh-remote state.
Nginx template proxies a group-owned 0660 Unix socket with Upgrade and access logging disabled.
Tunnel absence renders a minimal internal 503; backup hashes and rollback are verifiable.

stories.given: Local DSH and the tunnel are online
stories.goal: Open one long-lived private link on any device without entering account credentials
stories.then: The browser establishes a secure session and enters DSH, with refresh, root-relative resources, APIs, and WebSocket traffic working normally
stories.value: Use the complete currently running DSH, including realtime connections

stories.given: The public site is configured but the tunnel cannot serve DSH
stories.goal: See a clear unavailable page when local DSH or its tunnel is offline
stories.then: The VPS returns a minimal branded 503 page with a retry action and no infrastructure details
stories.value: Avoid an opaque proxy error or login prompt
stories.when: The owner opens the remote URL
